label: Wix App Market
terms_note: Automation via the official Wix CLI / App Extensions API is allowed; App Market listing is submitted from the app dashboard ('Submit & Publish') and passes an automated AI review in minutes (no more 15-day human queue); paid apps must use Wix billing + a payout account; revenue 100% year 1 then 80% after a 2.5% fee, $200 monthly payout minimum; rate limits not published (per-site data quotas exist).

reference.limits: Not published for App Management. Site data APIs have per-minute read / write quotas (`WDE0014: Requests per minute quota exceeded`). Treat 429 as retry-after. - App Market guidelines govern every listed app (performance, security, content); the review is now an **automated AI review** on Submit & Publish, results in minutes; Wix may audit retroactively; appeals through support tickets. - Paid apps bill through Wix (Wix = payment collection agent): 100 % revenue in year 1, 80 % afterwards, after a 2.5 % transaction fee and sales tax; net-30 EOM payouts, $200 monthly minimum. reason: Re-checked 2026-09-25 (markdown of the official pages): the App Market Listing API only 'lets you retrieve and search for app listings' and 'Search Market Listings ... returns only PUBLISHED listings' - listings are prepared and submitted in the app dashboard (https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/app-management/market-listing/introduction.md); Get Purchase History 'Retrieves a list of past purchases for your app on this site' with the site taken from the per-instance token context (https://dev.wix.com/docs/api-reference/app-management/app-billing/billing/get-purchase-history.md). There is no vendor-wide call to list sales, refunds or totals across installs, or to create a listing or change a price.
